'''Self-conforming chairs''' were pieces of furniture. [[Rithgar]], head of [[Kothlis shadowport]], had a self-conforming chair in his personal quarters. [[Tru'eb Cholakk]] relaxed in the chair during a visit to the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].
